fields.Name: T121 - AI Prompt Detail Slide-In Panel
fields.Description: Tests prompt-management's bespoke detail-panel overlay (detailPanelVisible / showPromptDetails / closeDetailPanel), a custom slide-in built in the dashboard - distinct from the generic entity form/record view.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), then open the Prompts section. On any prompt card (grid view) or row (list view), click the 'Details' / eye icon action. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away. Success is that a slide-in detail panel opens from the side showing that prompt's configuration (Status, Category, Type, Response Format, Selection Strategy, timestamps) with an 'Open Full Record' button. Seeing the detail panel render is success - you do NOT need to click Open Full Record. If there are no prompts, a valid empty state counts.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking the Details/eye action on a prompt opens a slide-in detail panel (overlay) rather than a full-page navigation
The panel shows prompt configuration fields (e.g. Status, Category, Type, Response Format) and an 'Open Full Record' action
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
